# archestra_agent_remote_delegations (Resource)

Authoritative external A2A subagent assignments for one agent. Declare one set per agent; apply replaces the full set and destroy clears assignments while preserving remote registrations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Declare one authoritative external connection set per agent.
resource "archestra_agent_remote_delegations" "external" {
  agent_id       = archestra_agent.parent.id
  connection_ids = [archestra_remote_agent.external.connection_id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Agent UUID. Pass the `id` from `archestra_agent`.
- `connection_ids` (Set of String) Remote connection UUIDs from archestra_remote_agent.connection_id; an empty set clears all external assignments.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `agent_id` — the assignment set has no id of its own

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_agent_remote_delegations.external "AGENT_ID"
```
